name: What maintenance is required for outdoor kitchens/pool houses?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for outdoor kitchens/pool houses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Annual stainless steel cleaning, resealing stone/concrete surfaces, clearing drains/gutters, inspecting gas lines, and re-waterproofing wood elements every 2-3 years.
